hypothesis: A sign-constrained composite policy (~10-20 params) over four frozen, individually-verified-real BTC signals (event-gate windows, contrarian 1m flow, GMM/IF anomaly, P3-role pivot exit + trailing envelope), optimized for WORST-QUARTER net PnL and selected only by quarterly LOWO, clears the maker-execution cost bar (~5-7bps roundtrip incl. ~1bp adverse selection, per the Stage-0 audit) on held-out quarters where every pooled-VAL-optimized predictor has failed.

research.prior_failure_reassessment: The three parent failures died for orthogonal, individually-documented reasons, none of which was 'the signal is not real': (1) global_1m_scalping -- contrarian flow confirmed real 5x but gross edge < TAKER costs; Kappa1 replaces taker entry with post-only maker entry, and the 2026-08-07 Stage-0 audit (docs/experiments/btc_kappa1_stage0_maker_fill_audit_20260807.json) measured 98.1% 15-min fill rate in event windows under a strict trade-through rule with only ~1bp adverse selection, cutting the cost bar roughly in half. (2) btc_zigzag_pivot_exit_primitives -- P3 proved true adverse-pivot bars are profitable to exit (t=2.2-8.2 every bucket/split) but precision dilution killed every standalone exit design; Kappa1 demotes the nowcast to exit-only inside an already-open position, where a false positive costs bounded forgone profit, not new risk. (3) btc_1h_native_swing_entry and the ~25 entry-axis failures before it share one signature: pooled-VAL optimization followed by OOS sign flip (5 reproductions); Kappa1 trains NO new predictor (frozen primitives, ~10-20 sign-constrained fusion params vs effective_n ~4k) and replaces the pooled objective with worst-quarter optimization + quarterly LOWO selection -- LOWO being the only selection method in this repo that ever passed a held-out test (Sigma6, 4/5). The event-gate closure condition ('do not resume without fundamentally new execution primitives') is satisfied by the maker-first primitive itself.
research.retest_design: Nothing is retrained: GMM/IF scores, event-gate series, and the G8-frozen pivot nowcaster are consumed read-only; the only fitted object is the fusion layer (weights >= 0 with pre-fixed signs, entry/size thresholds), optimized by CMA-ES from 5 genuinely random non-clustered seed initializations. Environments = calendar quarters 2025Q1..2026Q2 (dataset span 2025-01-01..2026-07-12). Objective = maximize worst-quarter net PnL (CVaR@25 tiebreak). Selection = leave-one-quarter-out: for each held-out quarter, optimize on the remaining quarters and evaluate frozen on the held-out one; pass requires >= 4/5 held-out quarters net-positive per seed AND sign-agreement across all 5 seeds AND >= 15 trades per held-out quarter. Single pooled-VAL selection is banned. Costs: maker 2bps entry + taker 5bps exit + 1bp measured adverse selection (7bps roundtrip conservative envelope, taker exit assumed as worst case), fills only where the Stage-0 conservative trade-through rule fills. Final promotion evidence can ONLY come from post-2026-08 accumulating fresh data (both historical OOS windows are spent); the LOWO table is a research gate, not a promotion claim.
